evidence:
Every plural / exactly-one / only / unchanged instance in the frozen criteria was enumerated and checked against the protocol that feeds it and the seed.

WHOLE-COLLECTION ASKS (all graded over the full set):
1. gates/constraints/judge.toml:23 'exactly one card for that candidate in Applied' - checks uniqueness, not a sample.
2. functional hro_job_open (judge.toml:29): each refused input (blank title, 0, 51, 2.5, non-manager) listed and run in protocol S (prompt.md:27).
3. hro_add_candidate (:38) 'in the order added' over all six J1 adds, independent context sees same order.
4. hro_reject_reason/hro_reopen/hro_reject_hired: 'only to the stage it was rejected from' is exercised on C (Applied->Screen refused) and, through R, on Interview and Offer rejections reopened to their own stages (hro_mgr_late_stages :146), so an always-to-Applied reopen fails.
5. hro_mgr_early_refused (:155), hro_observer_readonly (:173), hro_candidate_no_staff (:182), hro_anonymous (:191): each enumerates every request kind and says 'each ... refused'; 'Fails if any'.
6. hro_bulk_all_or_none (:218) and hro_bulk_places (:227): 'none of the set moves' / 'none moves' over V,Z and V,W,X by UI and replay.
7. hro_bulk_move (:209): whole three-card arrival order Y,W,X and mixed-stage A2,V.
8. hro_undo_restores (:236): every card of the three-card undo back at Y,W,X,Z,A2.
9. hro_undo_conflict (:245): all three conflict kinds (stage move B(10)-(11), in-stage reorder B(14), rejection B(15)) plus the unrelated-card control B(12).
10. hro_activity (:263): 'every successful board action ... each card of every single and multi-card move ... every undo', newest first, filter 'all of that job's lines and only those'; protocol A (prompt.md:49) lists every protocol S..V as in scope. hro_activity_refusals (:272) 'none of the refused attempts'.
11. hro_thread_latest/hro_thread_earlier (:317,:326): 'the wrong 30' and 'until none remain' over the whole long conversation.
12. hro_unread_counts (:335): 'exactly two', total by two, Mei's count computed from the observed sequence (prompt.md:41 gives the counting rule), Lena's seeded 1 (seed reads USR-CAN3/APP-301 read_count 2 of 3 messages - verified).
13. hro_candidate_private (:389): 'no response a candidate page receives' and protocol K (prompt.md:43) 'Capture every request ... inspect every response' including event-stream/socket payloads - whole collection, not a sample.
14. hro_thread_access (:362): every listed role and each replay; Mei is a non-opening recruiter of J2 so 'every recruiter' is meaningfully sampled.
15. hro_restart (:407): 'your jobs, card order per stage, notes, messages and activity lines' plus seeded order/note; 'anything is lost, reordered or duplicated'.
16. polish hro_pol_session_resume (polish/judge.toml:59): Mei must see neither of Rafael's two drafts; hro_pol_failed_send 'sent once' / 'sent twice'.
17. visual Likert anchors are per examined surface ('every examined surface'); no plural-sample issue.

'UNCHANGED' GUARDS VS LEGITIMATE SIDE EFFECTS:
- functional prompt.md:19 'A refused action must not change any card, order, message or note' matches rules 'A refused move changes nothing' (hireops_rules.md:70) and 'Undo is refused, changing nothing' (:115); no refused action in the protocols has a legitimate side effect.
- hro_undo_restores expects the legitimate shift of Z and A2 when Y,W,X return (Y,W,X,Z,A2), so the reflow is required, not punished.
- hro_undo_conflict B(12) explicitly tolerates a note on A2 and Mei's re-order of a different card (rules :116 'Adding a note does not count as a change').
- hro_pol_live_thread requires the view to stay at the newest and show Noor's message (legit auto-scroll at bottom is expected, not punished); hro_pol_live_board guards 'reset' of scroll, not reflow.
- Lena's seeded count and the Platform Engineer seed order are protected across dimensions: render/constraints 'do not open any conversation' / 'Do not move', polish 'Never use Lena Fischer's conversation', visual 'Do not move cards or send messages', and rewardkit runs one agent at a time (test.sh '--max-concurrent-agent 1'), so later readings are not broken by other dimensions' legitimate work. app_context.md:31 'never rely on a starting count'.
- hro_candidate_private 'other candidates': seed messages were scanned; candidate-visible conversations mention only the addressee (Tomas/Lena/Noor own names), so no seeded content would falsely trip the leak guard.
- Golden consistency: solution/app/src/index.js:312/365 bump version only for cards actually moved/undone; writeColumn (:200) renumbers positions without touching versions, so the golden passes B(12) wherever Y lands, and undo (:354-368) restores places with the reflow the criteria expect.

NOTES (latent, P3, not demonstrated defects):
(a) hro_candidate_view (:380) 'each candidate's own applications all appear' - the judge is never told Noor Haddad has a second seeded application (Product Designer, seed APP-302, stage APPLIED); app_context.md:29 and the prompt only name her Platform Engineer conversation. 'All' for Noor is therefore checkable only if the judge cross-references the staff boards. Tomas's two applications (seeded Data Analyst + new J2 card, both named in prompt.md:39) give a whole-collection control, so a one-application-per-candidate bug is still caught there.
(b) Protocol B(12) (prompt.md:35) says Mei 're-order a different J2 card (Y) within its stage' without 'one place' (contrast B(14) 'one place'). At that point Screen reads Y,W,X,Z,A2 (traced), so a single down-step leaves A2's place untouched; only if the judge pushes Y below A2 could an app that treats A2's shifted index as 're-ordered' be refused the control undo. Golden passes either way.

No runtime/judge evidence was needed to establish this static rubric-design row; no configured judge run, Oracle or model score is claimed.
counterexample: Tried: (1) broken app showing each candidate only one application (SQL .get instead of .all) - caught by hro_candidate_view/hro_candidate_linked via Tomas, whose two applications are both named in the prompt; (2) broken app that partially applies a refused bulk move - caught, criteria say 'none moves' over every card by UI and replay; (3) app logging one Activity line per multi-card move without cards - criterion explicitly accepts only a line naming every card with stages; (4) conforming app with whole-stage position renumbering - not punished by any unchanged guard (only positions of cards the action moved are asserted; undo reflow is expected). No credible pass-for-broken or fail-for-conforming counterexample found beyond the two P3 notes.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening: in app_context.md list each candidate account's seeded applications (Noor: Platform Engineer, Product Designer; Tomas: Data Analyst; Lena: Product Designer) so 'all appear' is checkable directly, and in protocol B(12) say 'move Y one place within its stage'.
